sdist.source: package index sdist digest; not carried

entry_point.run: boltzgen run <spec.yaml> --output <dir> ... (unseeded; one subprocess of resources/main.py per step)

cli_defaults.steps: all (protein-anything: design, inverse_folding, design_folding, folding, analysis, filtering)

seed_recipe.form: per step i of <dir>/steps.yaml, one process: pl.seed_everything(seed + i, workers=True); random.seed(seed + i); np.random.seed((seed + i) % (2**32)); torch.manual_seed(seed + i); np.random.default_rng(None) seeded from that stream's state (bg_hook.py = stock_design.seed_default_rng); then resources/main.py main(<config_i>, [])
seed_recipe.source: opt/forward/fast_inference/src/bg_inproc.py:38-40 and bg_hook.py (the kits' in-process contract); opt/boltzgen_opt/stock_design.py SEED_LINE + seed_default_rng (the stock caller, per step process, when --seed is given)

weights.source: sha256 per file, equal to the Hugging Face LFS digests of the pinned snapshots

stack_of_record.cuequivariance: 0.11.1 (cuequivariance, cuequivariance-torch; ops build cuequivariance-ops-torch-cu13 + cuequivariance-ops-cu13 0.11.1 = NVIDIA's published CUDA-13 pair for this torch)
stack_of_record.freeze_source: the carried kits' 103-line freeze with the deviation `freeze_deviation` applied: 101 distributions; environment/requirements.lock lists them as `pip freeze --all` prints them on the stack's interpreter — torch with its CUDA build (2.13.0+cu130), plus pip, setuptools and wheel (104 lines)
stack_of_record.tested_on: nvidia/cuda:13.0.1-base-ubuntu22.04 + python 3.11 + build-essential + this freeze, the freeze_deviation pair installed from the package index with --require-hashes (a label: nothing reads or compares it)

freeze_deviation.why: the kits' freeze pairs torch 2.13.0+cu130 with the CUDA-12 build of the cuEquivariance ops (plus that build's own nvidia-cublas-cu12 / nvidia-cuda-nvrtc-cu12, loaded into the same process as torch's CUDA-13 libraries); the stack of record carries NVIDIA's CUDA-13 build of the same version, whose libcue_ops.so links libcublas / libnvrtc 13 from torch's own wheels; module names, Python API and dispatch rules are identical
freeze_deviation.pip_check: boltzgen 0.3.2's wheel metadata (wheel_requires) names the -cu12 distributions, so `pip check` reports two unmet names on the stack of record; the -cu13 distributions provide the same modules (cuequivariance_ops, cuequivariance_ops_torch)

stock_environment.note: the stock arm is upstream alone in a pristine environment: no kit module, no kit directory on sys.path, no kit variable (every name under the prefixes and the three exact names above); the seed recipe above is harness code, not a lever
stock_environment.census: the one thing of this tree in the stock process: the accelerator census (opt/boltzgen_opt/census.py — the per-process monitor; the modes' policy over it, opt/boltzgen_opt/kernels.py, is never imported there), armed by argument after the environment proof of a GPU step; pass-through call counters on cuequivariance_ops_torch's two dispatch functions and their reference implementations, a pass-through observer on upstream's Boltz.predict_step that reads the TF32 switches each call runs under (no clock, no synchronisation, no line of its own), one KERNELS line (with its report-only stack words) and one PEAK line at exit; arguments and results untouched

gpu_of_record.name: NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3
gpu_of_record.gate: a visible GPU; a card other than this one by name or total memory is admitted with a NOTE line (gpu_gate=noted), which also says when the card is below min_compute_capability, the lowest capability the kit was run on — the card is never refused

prerequisites.gcc: Triton JIT-compiles a launcher at run time (upstream's cuEquivariance kernels at their first call; environment/Dockerfile installs build-essential)

step_config_defaults.source: the wheel's resources/config/{design,inverse_fold,fold}.yaml (what `boltzgen configure` writes unless a flag overrides it)

wheel_requires_note: the wheel's own metadata: it names the CUDA-12 ops distributions; the stack of record installs the CUDA-13 pair of the same version instead (stack_of_record.freeze_deviation)
